testflight.whats_new: 1.0.6 preview, TestFlight only. New in this build: a tidier progress card (a line between each part; the coach's Work on list in one panel with Practise my weak spots under it; what you're strong at as green tags), and every rank streak in full colour, since all of them can be played at any rank. Also in 1.0.6: missed puzzles come back on a schedule (after 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days), one mixed Practise my weak spots session, and your rating counting up or down after each puzzle. Tell me anything that looks off.
